create_VisDialDataset: create a VisDialDataset instance for visual dialog tasks with BERT tokenizer and image features reader
build_VisDialDataset_cache: build a cached VisDialDataset from VisDial annotations JSON with tokenized questions and answers
run_tokenizeQA: run tokenizeQA to convert VisDial questions, answers, and captions into BERT token ID lists
run_VisDialDataset_getitem: run __getitem__ on VisDialDataset to retrieve image features, dialog context, and answer candidates as tensors
run__truncate_seq: run _truncate_seq to truncate a token sequence in place to a specified maximum length
